[M] Immutable Diagram Revisions - shared content independent of canvas placement
|-- Identity separates the diagram, its revisions, and its parsed content
|   |-- diagramId: stable service identity across revisions
|   |-- DiagramRevision.id = Diagram.revisionId: identity of one immutable revision
|   |   `-- parentId records the base revision used by revise or derive
|   |-- Diagram.id: local canvas content key; Diagram.revision: numeric content revision
|   |   `-- content.revisionId = local id + ':' + numeric revision
|   `-- Revision owns the diagram payload and nodeRefs; context bindings live outside it
|-- [D] Reproducible content needs ASCII, structure kind, and pinned parser behavior
|   |-- buildDiagramContent -> ASCII hash + canonical content
|   |   |-- tree -> parseAsciiTree -> shared interpreter
|   |   |   `-- Store nodes, parent/child links, roots, and folding ranges
|   |   `-- diagram -> store ASCII and parser marker; derive nodes on demand
|   |-- diagramContentNodes exposes nodes through one boundary
|   |   |-- Tree nodes come from stored structure
|   |   |-- ascii-graph-1 uses graph boxes, including spans for multiline labels
|   |   `-- Unversioned diagrams retain legacy interpretation to preserve saved anchors
|   |       `-- [O] Derived diagram nodes are frozen and cached weakly by content object
|   `-- validateDiagram rebuilds with the stored parser version and requires exact equality
|       `-- Also checks service identities, source context, mappings, jumps, and highlights
|-- [C] Public commands prepare changes; private issuance creates immutable records
|   |-- createDiagram(input) -> editor.prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issue
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit) -> editor.prepareEdit
|   |   |-- Patch or replace content; optionally retain mappings and supply continuity claims
|   |   |-- Source-mapping edit requires expectedContentHash = base ASCII hash
|   |   |   `-- Mismatch -> CONTENT_HASH_CONFLICT; no revision returned
|   |   |-- Jump or highlight edits replace validated annotations
|   |   `-- Prepared payload is the same object as base.diagram?
|   |       |-- Yes -> return the existing revision
|   |       `-- No -> preserve diagramId, assign fresh revisionId -> issue with base parent
|   |-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources) -> prepare replacement -> issue with base parent
|   |   `-- Identity sources must share base.diagramId; each claimed ref selects one output node
|   |-- issueDiagramRevision -> assemble nodeRefs -> deepFreeze(record) -> validateDiagram
|   |   `-- Return DiagramRevisionResult; base revision remains unchanged
|   `-- Generation handoff: submitDiagramEdit(request, candidate, base)
|       |-- Check requested base revision and local diagram key; validate candidate in context
|       |-- Scoped edits preserve structure kind -> revise with patches and return output ranges
|       `-- Otherwise: requested base -> replace; no requested base -> create
|-- [D] Logical node continuity survives changes to content-node addresses
|   |-- Content node ID depends on content.revisionId + ASCII hash + parser-local anchor
|   |-- nodeRefs maps each content node ID to a persistent logical node identity
|   |   `-- Issuance chooses: explicit derived identity -> matched base identity -> fresh UUID
|   |-- Editor supplies old-to-new correspondence to issuance
|   |   |-- correspondingNodes fallback requires identical ASCII and structure kind
|   |   |   `-- Match a unique node by anchor line, columns, and label
|   |   `-- Explicit edit claims map an existing logical ref to one output node's anchor line
|   |       `-- Reject ambiguous targets, conflicting matches, or two identities on one node
|   `-- resolve(contextId, localDiagramId) follows binding -> revision -> nodeRefs
|       `-- Return a cloned view with logical node, parent/child, and active jump-source anchors
|-- [M] Source context binds diagram coordinates to captured evidence
|   |-- contentHash must equal SHA-256 of this diagram's ASCII
|   |-- [D] mapping.entityId -> evidence entity -> sourceRangeIndex -> pinned source lines
|   |   `-- Referenced range must exist; an optional sourceRangeId must agree
|   |-- Optional binding identifies source, repository, corpus, and domain profile
|   `-- diagramSource / queryDiagramSourceContext expose read-only joins
|       `-- Retrieve all entries, select by diagram rectangle, or search evidence metadata
`-- [O] Runtime retention and publication are separate responsibilities
    |-- Store facade depends on domain commands and the internal revision registry
    |   `-- Stored command -> domain result -> retainDiagramRevision
    |       |-- Import requires a nonempty, unique logical ref for every content node
    |       `-- Register, then retrieve: return the registry-held revision and payload
    |-- Domain commands can run without the store; retention alone does not publish a binding
    |-- Canvas history supplies context -> local diagram key -> exact revision ID bindings
    |   `-- Durable adapter contract: flush retained revisions before publishing bindings
    `-- merge checks binding maps, not diagram content
        |-- Any baseline/current difference -> MERGE_REQUIRED
        `-- Otherwise copy proposed bindings; automatic three-way merge is unimplemented
